content:
[Intro]
[Bb]
[Bbsus2/A]
[Gm]
[Ebmaj7]

[Verse 1]
[Bb]Let's talk about the old
[Bbsus2/A]days
[Gm]Let's talk about your friends
[Ebmaj7]
[Bb]Let's talk about the sum-
[Bbsus2/A]mer
[Gm]And how you wish it wouldn't end
[Ebmaj7]
[Bb]Did I forget to tell
[Bbsus2/A]you
[Gm]How pretty you looked in that
[Ebmaj7]dress?
[Bb]In the first time that I
[Bbsus2/A]saw you
[Gm]You cleaned the mess from my
[Ebmaj7]head

[Chorus]
[Cm]And I don't mind
[F]
[Bb]If we [Bbsus2/A]take our time
[Gm]
[Ebmaj7]No,
[F]I don't mind

[Bridge]
[Bb]

[Verse 2]
[Bb]Lets go walkin' on the board-
[Bbsus2/A]walk
[Gm]Dip our feet into the
[Ebmaj7]sea
[Bb]Lets find ourselves lost for ho-
[Bbsus2/A]urs
[Gm]Until we find ourselves a drink
[Ebmaj7]
[Bb]Lets talk that sun into set-
[Bbsus2/A]ting
[Gm]Just need the sound of your
[Ebmaj7]voice
[Bb]Need that calming and the com-
[Bbsus2/A]fort
[Gm]Something to drown out the noise
[Ebmaj7]

[Chorus]
[Cm]And I don't mind
[F]
[Bb]If we [Bbsus2/A]take our time
[Gm]Cause
[Ebmaj7]I'm all yours If
[F]you're all mine

[Bridge]
[Bb]

[Verse 3]
[Bb]Something I've been meanin' to tell
[Bbsus2/A]you
[Gm]About three years and a day
[Ebmaj7]
[Bb]I'd very much like to get mar-
[Bbsus2/A]ried
[Gm]Maybe have kids and move away
[Ebmaj7]
[Bb]Cause there ain't nothing like your smi-
[Bbsus2/A]le
[Gm]Your legs and those
[Ebmaj7]eyes
[Bb]I will beg and steal and bor-
[Bbsus2/A]row
[Gm]To keep you safe your whole
[Ebmaj7]life

[Chorus]
[Cm]And I don't mind
[F]
[Bb]If we [Bbsus2/A]take our time
[Gm]Cause
[Ebmaj7]I'm all yours If
[F]you're all mine

[Bridge]
[Bb]
[Bbsus2/A]

[Outro]
[Bb]
[Bbsus2/A]
[Gm]
[Ebmaj7]
[Bb]
[Bbsus2/A]
[Gm]
[Ebmaj7]
[F]
[Bb]
title: I Don't Mind
tuning: D G C F A D
